mapper.sql: policy_id AS policyId, policy_code AS policyCode, revision_no AS revisionNo, rule_schema_version AS ruleSchemaVersion, allowed_mime_rules AS allowedMimeRules, max_size_bytes AS maxSizeBytes, effective_from AS effectiveFrom, effective_to AS effectiveTo, status, active_slot AS activeSlot, version, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_file_scan_policy ORDER BY policy_code, revision_no DESC
SELECT FROM t_file_scan_policy WHERE policy_code = #{policyCode} ORDER BY revision_no DESC
SELECT FROM t_file_scan_policy WHERE policy_code = #{policyCode} ORDER BY revision_no DESC FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM t_file_scan_policy WHERE policy_code = #{policyCode} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND active_slot = 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_file_scan_policy (policy_id, policy_code, revision_no, rule_schema_version, allowed_mime_rules, max_size_bytes, effective_from, effective_to, status, active_slot, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.policyId}, #{row.policyCode}, #{row.revisionNo}, #{row.ruleSchemaVersion}, #{row.allowedMimeRules}, #{row.maxSizeBytes}, #{row.effectiveFrom}, #{row.effectiveTo}, #{row.status}, #{row.activeSlot}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_file_scan_policy SET allowed_mime_rules = #{allowedMimeRules}, max_size_bytes = #{maxSizeBytes}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE policy_id = #{row.policyId} AND version = #{row.version} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_file_scan_policy WHERE policy_id = #{row.policyId} AND version = #{row.version} AND status = 'DRAFT'
